{"code": "
import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to tapping mode (PhaseContrast) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast

# Set scan parameters for 20x20 µm² image with 128x128 resolution
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set a descriptive filename
file_name = "topography_20x20um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print("AFM scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Scan size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  Operating mode: PhaseContrast (Tapping mode)")
print(f"  Filename mask: {file_name}")

# Start the scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the saved file path
# The file is automatically saved by the system
# We need to find the most recent file in the workspace
workspace_path = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_3_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_3"

# List all files in the workspace to find the most recent one
import glob
files = glob.glob(os.path.join(workspace_path, "**", "*.*"), recursive=True)
if files:
    # Get the most recently modified file
    latest_file = max(files, key=os.path.getmtime)
    print(f"\nSaved image path: {latest_file}")
else:
    print(f"\nWorkspace path: {workspace_path}")

del spm
"}
